_about: Glossary (GlossaryScene, user's pick: a book with chapters, docs/proposals/menu/glossary-book.png). Entries fill in as you meet them (systems/glossary.js, saved in progress.seen at every floor clear and at the end of a run). basics = always open help pages (BASICS chapter = a DROP-DOWN list: tap a title to open its picture + text; `visual` = a picture drawn by scenes/glossary/basicVisuals.js, layout.basics.visuals = which sprites / items it uses). statuses = one line per status; tab = bad / good / control; statuses not listed are hidden. shortNames = enemy names in the small grid tiles (9 letters fit; longer names show their last word). hiddenEnemies = boss parts and props that are not shown as enemies. layout = screen px.

basics.title: YOUR SQUAD
basics.text: 3 heroes. A fallen hero is gone for the rest of the run. When all 3 fall, the run ends.

basics.title: FLOORS
basics.text: Each floor is a fight or a special room. A boss every 20 floors. Clear a floor to get a reward.

basics.title: AUTO BATTLE
basics.text: Heroes move and attack on their own. You use their skills and choose who to hit.

basics.title: SKILLS
basics.text: Red = attack skill, green = support skill. Tap to use, then it cools down.

basics.title: TAP AND DRAG
basics.text: Tap an enemy: the whole squad attacks it. Drag a hero onto an enemy: only that hero does.

basics.title: DAMAGE TYPES
basics.text: Physical: melee and ranged. Magic: fire, ice, electric, dark and holy.

basics.title: DEFENSE AND RESIST
basics.text: Defense cuts physical damage, resist cuts magic. More always helps, but never to zero.

basics.title: WEAK AND RESIST
basics.text: An enemy weak to a damage type takes more from it. One that resists it takes less.

basics.title: CRIT AND DODGE
basics.text: A crit hits much harder. A dodge takes no damage at all.

basics.title: ITEMS
basics.text: Items work on their own. Each goes to one hero. Copies stack.

basics.title: LEVELS
basics.text: Kills give XP to the heroes still standing. Each level makes a hero stronger.

basics.title: PERKS AND PASSIVES
basics.text: Each hero gives the squad a perk while alive, and has a passive of their own.

basics.title: ON-HIT ITEMS
basics.text: Some items have a chance to add something to each hit (bleed, burn, a bonus hit). Skills marked ON-HIT roll them too.

basics.title: CHANNEL
basics.text: A skill that lasts a while. The hero does nothing else until it ends.

basics.title: REACTIONS
basics.text: Fire, ice and electric hits mark the enemy. A different element on top reacts: Steam (Blind), Shatter (+50% hit), Overload (fire burst).

basics.title: MIXING ELEMENTS
basics.text: Each extra element among a hero's items cuts their elemental damage a little. Items marked 'one element' count as one.

bleed.text: Physical damage every second. Defense does not help. Stacks.

doom.text: Dark damage over time, slower attacks, less resist.

armorBreak.text: Less defense: takes more physical damage.

curse.text: Less resist: takes more magic damage.

tangled.text: Caught in sticky webs: much slower attacks.

chill.text: -10% attack speed per stack. 5 stacks = FREEZE.

freeze.text: Frozen solid: cannot attack or cast.

shock.text: Slower attacks, may fumble an attack.

knockback.text: Pushed back: its attack starts over.

taunt.text: Must attack the one who taunted it.

charm.text: Fights for the other side for a while.

parry.text: Ready to counter the next hit.

guaranteedCrit.text: The next hit is a sure crit.

guarded.text: An ally takes hits for it.

reflect.text: Sends damage back to the attacker.
